title: Merchant decision table for signed agent requests
caption: Mastercard's Level 1 guide gives merchants a short decision table, and Cloudflare lists the same checks at the edge. Untagged traffic falls back to the ordinary bot policy; a missing field or an unknown key blocks the request.
alt: Flowchart. Does the request carry Signature-Input with a scheme tag? If no, apply the non-agent bot policy. If yes, are all required fields present? If no, block. Is the key found in the directory? If no, block. Are created and expires valid and the nonce unused? If no, block. Does the signature verify? If no, block. If yes, treat as a trusted agent.
